title: Will a meditation app spread through a small society?

engine.structure: Watts-Strogatz small-world network (k=4, p=0.15), Mesa/AgentPy-compatible design

design: 36 synthetic agents (archetype personas only; no real personal data), 4 seed adopters, 5 steps. Each step, every non-adopter's decision is one Jev call (adopt noul + action choice + openness score); adoption is sampled Bernoulli(adopt probability). The intervention arm adds the Manager stimulus to the state from step 3. Everything else identical.
